models_evaluated: UPMC gradient-boosted decision tree preoperative surgical risk model

links.outcome: Mortality prediction accuracy of ML model versus NSQIP calculator on same 902 patients
links.effect: Model beat NSQIP: AUROC 0.945 vs 0.897 (difference 0.048); specificity 0.87 vs 0.68; accuracy 0.85 vs 0.69.
links.quote: The model outperformed the NSQIP tool as measured by AUROC (0.945 [95% CI, 0.914-0.977] vs 0.897 [95% CI, 0.854-0.941], for a difference of 0.048), specificity (0.87 [95% CI, 0.83-0.89] vs 0.68 [95% CI, 0.65-0.69]), and accuracy (0.85 [95% CI, 0.82-0.87] vs 0.69 [95% CI, 0.66, 0.72]).

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively validates a preoperative risk prediction model across a health system (live clinical deployment data), but evaluates model discrimination/accuracy rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
